ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) background with high-intensity (white) pixel clusters and lines; approximately 85:15 dark-to-light ratio across the visible fluke area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous dark base pigmentation. High-intensity white pixels are concentrated along the trailing edges and terminal tips. Sparse, high-contrast white linear and curvilinear marks are distributed across the entire 2D surface of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression; calculated interior angle of approximately 115 degrees relative to the lobe intersection point.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude irregularity. Multiple distinct peaks and valleys are present, particularly a deep jagged indentation on the inner-right lobe and consistent small-scale serrations along the left lobe trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature from the peduncle attachment point moving distally toward the tips, with a slight concavity approaching the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-contrast circular pixel clusters visible at the extreme distal tips and intermittently along the trailing edges of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive presence of multi-directional linear marks. Parallel sets of white lines (rake-like patterns) are visible on the medial and lateral surfaces of both the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Highly irregular and jagged trailing edge boundary with significant tissue discontinuities; dense coverage of white linear and curvilinear scar tissue across the ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Visible concentric circular marking pattern in the upper-medial region of the left lobe.
